Banking

Open the right accounts, keep business and personal money truly separate, and start building business credit before you ever need it.

90 minutes · live, small group

What we'll cover

  • Opening the right business checking (and when you need savings)
  • Keeping business and personal money truly separate
  • Starting to build business credit early
  • Simple habits that keep your books clean from day one

What you'll walk out with

A plan for your accounts and first steps toward business credit.

About this class

Who is Banking for?

Women founders who are just starting out — no prior experience assumed. It's part of The Foundations, the plain-language business fundamentals track.

2

None — every Quinta & Co. class is plain language and hands-on.

3

A plan for your accounts and first steps toward business credit. Every Quinta & Co. class ends with something real you keep.

4

Enrollment opens Fall 2026. Join the waitlist at quintaand.co/waitlist to hear first — and the free monthly Coffee with Quinta is open in the meantime.
